purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks. Positives ask what a coding agent can reach; near misses belong to sibling skills or to no skill.

cases.prompt: what can my coding agent actually read and write on this machine
cases.assert: Explains what the probe touches, runs probe.py once without --network, and leads with its headline.

cases.prompt: is the Claude Code sandbox really protecting my SSH keys and .env files
cases.assert: Runs the probe inside the sandbox and reports secret files as open or blocked, plus settings gaps.

cases.prompt: how big is the blast radius if my agent gets prompt injected
cases.assert: Reports the reach table grouped by risk, Critical first.

cases.prompt: could the agent escape the sandbox through Docker or sudo
cases.assert: Reports the Docker socket and sudo checks and the matching fixes.

cases.prompt: check which secrets and credentials Codex can access from its shell
cases.assert: Runs the probe through the Codex shell and compares the result with sandbox_mode.

cases.prompt: can the agent write to my git hooks or shell startup files
cases.assert: Reports the trust-handoff rows for git hooks and shell startup files.

cases.prompt: test whether my deny rules block git push --force
cases.assert: Belongs to guardrail-tester: testing permission rules and hooks against dangerous commands.

cases.prompt: which instruction files does Codex load from this repo
stop the session when it loops or spends more than ten dollars
how many tokens do my MCP servers add to every session
scan my git history for leaked API keys
cases.assert: A secret scanner such as gitleaks; this skill checks access, not file contents.

cases.prompt: turn the never use npm rule in my CLAUDE.md into a hook
